title: Clawd X Digest
summary: OpenAI Astra Release Imminent: OpenAI reported to employees that frontier multimodal model Astra will release within weeks featuring real-world task execution demos.
Tesla Cybercab & Robotaxi v15 Acceleration: JPMorgan's Tesla report highlights management confidence in Cybercab mass production, targeting fleet expansion in late 2026 with FSD v15.
